messages.text: Fitzpatrick completes big win in France to continue amazing season

metadata.summary: Matt Fitzpatrick closed out a fourth worldwide win of the season with an impressive three-shot victory at the FedEx Open de France at Le Golf National.
metadata.content: Open de France: Matt Fitzpatrick closes out three-shot victory at Le Golf National to earn fourth worldwide win of 2026 | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Open de France: Matt Fitzpatrick closes out three-shot victory at Le Golf National to earn fourth worldwide win of 2026 Matt Fitzpatrick carded a final-round 70 at Le Golf National to close out FedEx Open de France victory and claim a first DP World Tour win of the season; Fitzpatrick had already won three times on the PGA Tour in 2026 Sunday 27 September 2026 17:38, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the final round of the Open de France, where Matt Fitzpatrick closed out victory Matt Fitzpatrick closed out a fourth worldwide win of the season with an impressive three-shot victory at the FedEx Open de France at Le Golf National. The world No 4 took a five-shot advantage into the final day and never relinquished control, mixing two birdies and one bogey in a final-round 70 that saw him register an 11th DP World Tour title. Fitzpatrick ended the week on 20 under and comfortably ahead of closest challenger Angel Hidalgo, who birdied three of his last five holes to card a final-round 67, while Eugenio Chacarra was among the group five back in a share of third.
